title: Inner product of Gaussian $L^2$ classes
statement: For every natural number $n$ and functions $f,g:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ that belong to $L^2$ for standard Gaussian measure $\gamma_n$, the inner product of their $L^2$ classes is $\int f(x)g(x)\,d\gamma_n(x)$.
